# Archive API headers

Public headers from libarchive v3.3.3, with one indentation-only correction in `archive.h`.
The native macOS extraction helper links the
operating system's libarchive; these headers provide declarations, not a bundled archive engine.
The copyright and redistribution terms are retained in each header. Include these notices with
the packaged helper when it is added to release assembly.

Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.3.3/libarchive

Original upstream SHA-256 (before the indentation correction):

- `archive_entry.h`: `2badd3cb7e238508837973e636c22b94d251dde3c3a668c28ea0183a18d00780`
